CFML Language Reference: Functions

IsBoolean

Returns YES if the value can be used as a Boolean: the strings "Yes", "No", "True" and "False" (in any case), or any number.

Category

Decision functions

Syntax

IsBoolean(value)

Parameters

value
Any value.

Returns

YES or NO.

Usage

Every number counts as a Boolean: 0 is false and anything else is true. So IsBoolean("12") is YES, while IsBoolean("maybe") is NO. Handy for validating "Yes/No" URL parameters before using them in a CFIF.

Example

Opens the example in a new window. The example runs on this server, so it only works when you browse from the server itself (127.0.0.1).
<CFPARAM NAME="URL.ShowAll" DEFAULT="Yes">
<TABLE BORDER=1 CELLPADDING=3>
<TR><TH>value</TH><TH>IsBoolean</TH></TR>
<CFLOOP INDEX="v" LIST="Yes,no,TRUE,false,0,12,-1.5,maybe,Y2K">
<CFOUTPUT><TR><TD>#v#</TD><TD>#IsBoolean(v)#</TD></TR></CFOUTPUT>
</CFLOOP>
</TABLE>
<CFIF IsBoolean(URL.ShowAll) AND URL.ShowAll>
  <P>URL.ShowAll is a valid Boolean and it is true.
<CFELSE>
  <P>URL.ShowAll is false or not a Boolean.
</CFIF>

See also

IsNumeric, YesNoFormat, IIf
